title: Dedup State — Design B (Flink keyed MapState, native TTL)
description: Design-B fingerprint dedup (CHG-022/023, 2026-08-17): the 1-minute dedup set is authoritative Flink keyed MapState with native StateTtlConfig (DEDUP_TTL_MS=60000, ProcessingTime, OnCreateAndWrite). No Fluss dedup table, no cache, no cleanup backlog, no rehydration (the DEC-038 Fluss store is removed). Gauges: compute.dedup.state.count (live entries, TTL-resynced), compute.dedup.state.bytes.estimate (RocksDB). Counters: compute.dedup.first (accepted), compute.dedup.duplicates (dropped). Source: FingerprintDedupFunction -> flink-metrics-otel -> otel-collector:4318 -> metrics.

panels.title: Live dedup entries — compute.dedup.state.count
panels.description: Per-subtask gauge of the current live MapState entry count (TTL-aware resync: expired entries skipped). Expected = first-seen rate × TTL horizon (5 min). Bounded by accepted rate, never by a cache cap.

queries.query: SELECT max(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_state_count' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Dedup state bytes estimate — compute.dedup.state.bytes.estimate
panels.description: Per-subtask estimated RocksDB bytes for the dedup MapState. Monitors state growth vs the checkpoint contract (state IS authoritative — checkpoint grows with the live set by design).

queries.query: SELECT max(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_state_bytes_estimate' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Accepted first-seen rate — compute.dedup.first
panels.description: Delta of first-seen acceptances (new fingerprints admitted). Rate = live-set growth rate; steady-state should equal new-fingerprint arrival.

queries.query: SELECT rate(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_first' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Duplicate drop rate — compute.dedup.duplicates
panels.description: Delta of dropped duplicates (re-arrivals within TTL). Expected ≈ re-delivery rate; a spike signals replay or a re-connect storm.

queries.query: SELECT rate(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_duplicates' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x
